start_here: Say to your AI: "Time every word of take.wav from 2.5 s to 3.25 s and write the words to take.words.json." It runs tool:time-words-in-a-recording on your computer and writes each word with its start and end in source seconds.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads one recording on your computer and writes one words file beside it.
instructions: 1. Install python, ffmpeg and a Whisper backend whisper_here.py can use (mlx-whisper, faster-whisper or openai-whisper) on your computer.
2. Write one JSON request file with source and out, and optionally from and to in source seconds and a model, for example {"source":"./take.wav","out":"./take.words.json","from":2.5,"to":3.25}.
3. Say "Time the words of that recording"; the AI runs tool:time-words-in-a-recording with the request file's path.
4. Read the last line it prints, {"result": {"out", "words"}}, then open the out file: every word has text, start and end in the source's own seconds.
